impact: Another big downgrade keeps pressure on the AI chip complex; MU and NBIS tend to trade with Nvidia sentiment into its earnings.
summary: HSBC downgraded Nvidia to hold and cut its price target to $170 from $375, citing uncertainty after Jensen Huang's resignation. Nvidia closed Friday at about $162.86, roughly 13% below its Nov. 6 close of $186.64, and reports earnings Tuesday with no permanent CEO named.
title: HSBC cuts Nvidia to hold, slashes target to $170 from $375
